The Interledger community calls shall be once a month, on the second Wednesday of the month.

We have two things scheduled for this call:

  1. ‘Getting started with Rafiki’ session by @sabinebertram and
  2. We’ll have 5 regular update slots from:
  • Interledger Foundation
  • Rafiki
  • Fynbos
  • Coil
  • Open Payments teams
    with additional slots open for anyone that would like to share their project or a discussion item for the broader community.

The next community call will be on 2022-10-12T15:00:00Z → 2022-10-12T16:00:00Z
